title: Create an exemption for the pod label

blocks.content: You exempt `pod` on every metric so recommendations do not aggregate that label.

1. Open **Adaptive Metrics**.
1. Open **Configuration**.
1. Click **Add new exemption**. The dialog title is **Add exemption**.
1. Next to **Metric**, turn **All** on. The metric shows **All metrics**.
1. In **Keep labels**, enter `pod`.
1. Leave **Disable recommendations for this metric and preserve existing rule state** off. That checkbox clears **Keep labels**.
1. Click **Save**.

The exemption is in the list on **Configuration**. You edit or delete it from that list.

On **Metrics**, open a rule and the **Exemptions** tab to see whether an exemption affects that rule. Refer to [Create exemptions](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-metrics/create-exemptions/).
